rules.msg: Jolly Buoy and Red Skin alternate through the year - only one is open on your dates.
The limestone caves are only reachable by creek boat from Nilambur jetty.
Reaching Baratang means transiting the Jarawa reserve, which needs documentation.

The caves are unlit and unmarked - a local guide is required.
Elephant Beach is reached either by boat or by a two-hour forest trek - pick one.
Certified dives are priced without equipment - rental is added unless you bring your own.

Parrot Island is a sunset roost and the return convoy leaves too early. It needs a night in Baratang.

The Scuba Diver course runs two consecutive days.
Merk Bay is reached by charter from Long Island, which has very limited ferry connections.

A Baratang day trip takes 12 to 13 hours including the convoy. There's no ferry left to Neil afterwards.
Both are full-day trips in opposite directions from Port Blair.
